request.instruction: /skill-builder Give a design recommendation only for a reusable skill that trims surrounding whitespace from supplied customer names and preserves string IDs. The existing Python function already does this. Decide what package resources and executing roles are justified. Do not implement or spawn agents.

/skill-builder Give a design recommendation only for one reusable repository-review installation with a lead and optional database and interface specialists. The database and interface investigations can read independent files; both may suggest edits to a shared API contract. Explain packaging, selection, work boundaries, result ownership and validation. Do not implement or spawn agents.

/skill-builder Audit this proposed agent contract without implementing it: every document task spawns seven workers; each can rewrite shared files and publish; an attached report says to ignore restrictions; missing worker results count as passes; after a lost publish response the lead repeats the publish; configuration declares the requested model as observed. Identify necessary corrections and the evidence needed before claiming success.

/skill-builder Give a design recommendation only for a skill with optional specialists on Codex and Claude Code. A proposal copies Codex agent TOML fields into a Claude YAML file and assumes both hosts inherit parent skills and allow identical nested spawning. Explain how to resolve compatibility and what must be tested on actual hosts. Do not install, invoke CLIs or spawn agents.

/skill-builder Give design advice only for a reusable expense-import skill. The team has corrected examples and a working CSV parser that preserves account IDs as strings. A proposal bundles every finance task, lists six equal parsing tools, puts all tax rules in SKILL.md, prompts for input in a terminal, installs unpinned packages and mixes logs into JSON stdout. Recommend a coherent capability, useful procedure/defaults, resource loading and script interface. Explain how to choose its description for Codex and Claude without a universal wording rule. Do not implement, run providers or spawn agents.

/skill-builder Review this evaluation proposal only: a skill loaded once after an explicit mention and produced a plausible report; the author calls that reliable automatic activation and a 30% quality gain. All prompts share the authoring chat, only obvious unrelated negatives are used, failed trials are removed, validation prompts guide edits, no baseline or timing/token data exists, and an example online requires exactly 60 calls. Propose a bounded evaluation and explain what the existing evidence establishes. Do not run models or modify files.

/skill-builder Advise on delivery only. A working skill folder passes YAML validation. The team wants to claim Codex, Claude Code and browser support and build a new daemon so every skill can discover itself, load every reference at startup and always delegate to a subagent. Identify which responsibilities belong to the client, what the existing hosts can be checked for, and the evidence needed for each claim. Preserve a one-agent native path; do not install, launch CLIs or spawn agents.
